name: Bob Bergen
profileSummary: Bob Berger, known professionally as Bob Bergen, is an American voice actor and television personality. He voices Warner Bros. cartoon characters Porky Pig and Tweety and has voiced characters in the English dubs of various anime. He formerly hosted the children's game show Jep!, adapted from the game show Jeopardy!. Including all this roles, he is among the highest-grossing actors of all time.
